mapper.select: SELECT ID, BUSINESS_ID, BUSINESS_TYPE, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, FILE_TYPE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG FROM T_ATTACHMENT WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = 0

SELECT ID, BUSINESS_ID, BUSINESS_TYPE, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, FILE_TYPE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG FROM T_ATTACHMENT WHERE BUSINESS_ID = #{businessId} AND BUSINESS_TYPE = #{businessType} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT ID, BUSINESS_ID, BUSINESS_TYPE, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, FILE_TYPE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG FROM T_ATTACHMENT WHERE CREATE_BY = #{createBy} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT FILE_TYPE AS fileType, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(FILE_SIZE) AS totalSize FROM T_ATTACHMENT WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0
AND CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND CREATE_TIME <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY FILE_TYPE
